title: The Four Horsemen: Amazon/Apple/Facebook & Google - Who Wins/Loses (Scott Galloway, L2 Inc.) | DLD15
summary: Scott Galloway's DLD15 talk assessing the competitive positions of Amazon, Apple, Facebook and Google. He argues about where each is strong and weak, including Amazon's need for physical retail.
why: Shared in 2015 threads as an insightful framework for strategic moves by the big tech companies.

quote.text: very insightful video on why Amazon has reached a point where they must make a brick and mortar acquisition
